Application Fees and Fee Waivers
Application Fees
The graduate programs application fee is $75. This fee is required for all applicants unless you are eligible for an application fee waiver.
Application Fee Waiver Criteria
This fee is automatically waived upon submission for candidates who attend an admissions event*, receive a fee waiver code, or for applicants who are current members or former participants in one or more of the following organizations:
AmeriCorps
Beta Gamma Sigma
Brandeis alum and current students
Brandeis Employee
Brandeis Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU) program
City Year
Fulbright Program / IIE / Amideast
Govern for America
Institute for Recruitment of Teachers
Peace Corps
Public Policy and International Affairs
Teach for America
The Posse Foundation
United States Military
*You must attend an admissions event before submitting your application to be eligible for an event fee waiver.
